FAQ

Questions creators ask before exporting

Are these final prices?

Starter is Rs. 500 per month for 10 captioned videos, Creator is Rs. 1000 per month for 30 videos, and Custom plans are available for higher-volume teams. Confirm billing rules before payments go live.

Can I cancel a subscription?

Cancellation rules should be confirmed in the billing system. The launch policy should make cancellation terms clear before checkout.

How do refunds work?

Refund terms are described in the Refund Policy and should be reviewed before paid launch.

Do export credits expire?

Monthly video limits are plan-based. Confirm whether unused monthly limits roll over before production checkout goes live.

What happens if an export fails?

Failed export handling should be defined before launch, including whether credits are restored or support review is required.
